# Al Esharah Fashion Ltd
Al Esharah Fashion is a leading garments manufacturer and apparel exporter based in Bangladesh, providing premium-quality clothing solutions for global fashion brands, wholesalers, retailers, and private label businesses.

## Core Specializations
- Modest Fashion: Thobes, Saudi thobe, Omani khaleej, Dubai thobe, Jubba, Abaya.
- Traditional & Casual: Panjabi, shirts, polo shirts, t-shirts, jackets, and hoodies.
- Services: Garment sourcing, apparel design, manufacturing, embroidery, printing, and custom private label production.

## Key Pages
- [About Us](https://www.alesharahfashions.com/about) - Learn about our 13+ years of experience and manufacturing capabilities.
- [Products Gallery](https://www.alesharahfashions.com/products) - View our range of export-quality garments and apparel.
- [Services](https://www.alesharahfashions.com/services) - Details on our manufacturing, design, and sourcing services.
- [Contact Us](https://www.alesharahfashions.com/contact) - Get in touch for bulk orders, wholesale inquiries, and partnerships.

## Manufacturing Capabilities
We operate with modern production facilities, BSCI compliance, and ethical standards to serve markets across the USA, UK, Europe, and the Middle East. We specialize in custom apparel production and OEM services.
